record.paper_title: Open Problems on Syzygies and Hilbert Functions
record.original_question: For every artinian graded finitely generated S-module M, is the sum of all total Betti numbers at least 2^n?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be a field, let $S = k[x_1, \dots, x_n]$ be the polynomial ring in $n$ variables with its standard grading, and let $M$ be a finitely generated graded $S$-module. Assume that $M$ is artinian (equivalently, $\dim_k M < \infty$). For each $i \geq 0$, let
$$\beta_i(M) = \dim_k \operatorname{Tor}_i^S(M, k)$$
denote the $i$-th total Betti number of $M$, which equals the rank of the $i$-th free module in the minimal graded free resolution of $M$ over $S$.

Prove or disprove: for every such artinian graded finitely generated $S$-module $M$,
$$\sum_{i=0}^{n} \beta_i(M) \;\geq\; 2^n.$$
artifact.status_search_result: This is the Total Rank Conjecture (a weakening of the Buchsbaum–Eisenbud–Horrocks rank conjecture). Walker (Annals of Math., 2017) proved the inequality for rings in which 2 is invertible (in particular for graded modules over polynomial rings of odd or zero characteristic). The characteristic-two case was subsequently addressed by VandeBogert–Walker (arXiv:2305.09771), establishing further cases but the full Buchsbaum–Eisenbud–Horrocks conjecture (the sharper individual bounds $\beta_i \geq \binom{n}{i}$) remains open in general.

status_evidence.title: Total Betti numbers of modules of finite projective dimension
status_evidence.snippet: The Total Rank Conjecture was proved by Walker for rings of odd characteristic using Adams operations on perfect complexes with finite length homology.
status_evidence.claim: The sum-of-Betti-numbers lower bound $\geq 2^n$ is established for finitely generated modules of finite projective dimension and finite length when 2 is invertible.

status_evidence.title: The Total Rank Conjecture in Characteristic Two
status_evidence.snippet: Addresses the remaining characteristic-two case of the Total Rank Conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent work extends the result to additional cases in characteristic two.

status_evidence.title: Lower bounds on Betti numbers (Boocher–Grifo)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey on the Buchsbaum–Eisenbud–Horrocks conjecture and related lower bounds for Betti numbers.
status_evidence.claim: The full Buchsbaum–Eisenbud–Horrocks conjecture remains open in general.
